title: Stopping time, force and injury

title: Bring motion and safety together

visuals.title: Connect prevention and impact protection
visuals.caption: Reaction and braking determine stopping distance. During an impact, a longer stopping interval can reduce mean force for the same momentum change. Use the relevant model for each question.
visuals.credit: Original course diagram authored for Science 24.
visuals.reviewStatus: Lead science/source review and Chromium layouts passed; teacher acceptance pending
visuals.placement: Full reading width before the related explanation; native SVG maximum 600px, raster maximum 800px.
visuals.scientificReview: Reaction distance v×t plus braking distance distinguished from impact impulse Δp = Fmean×Δt. Longer impact duration reduces mean force for the same momentum change.
